content_policy: The corpus contains original AD-TriAgent operational review guides. Each guide preserves source links, reuse notes, and limitations. It does not store copied third-party passages, ISO standards, OEM material, or incident telemetry.

documents.title: Safety and trajectory conflict review guide
documents.reuse_basis: Original project-authored operational guide informed by public U.S. Government safety and surrogate-measure references. No source text is reproduced.
documents.summary: A structured guide for interpreting trajectory conflict evidence as an investigation signal rather than a root-cause verdict.
investigation_prompts: Reconstruct the interaction around minimum TTC: relative speed, trajectory overlap, braking or steering response, and the evidence available to each subsystem.
documents.limitations: Surrogate safety measures show interaction criticality; they do not identify a software subsystem, prove fault, or set a universal threshold.

documents.title: Perception, localisation, and occlusion review guide
documents.reuse_basis: Original project-authored operational guide with an attributed link to an open-access CC BY scenario-study reference. No article text is reproduced.
documents.summary: A guide for separating observability, state-estimation, tracking, and downstream interaction questions in a review.
investigation_prompts: Identify whether the evidence indicates an observability gap, a localisation/state-estimation issue, a track-quality issue, or an unresolved downstream response question.
documents.limitations: A low confidence score or occlusion hypothesis is not evidence of a sensor-stack root cause without logs, calibration context, and reviewer analysis.

documents.title: Scenario, ODD, fallback, and handover review guide
documents.reuse_basis: Original project-authored operational guide informed by public U.S. Government ADS safety guidance and reference-only scenario-method material. No publication text is reproduced.
documents.summary: A guide for describing a repeatable scenario and distinguishing a planned capability boundary from an unexplained failure.
investigation_prompts: Describe the replay as a logical scenario, then identify whether ODD, fallback, handover timing, system health, or missing context requires human investigation.
documents.limitations: The guide is not compliance advice and cannot determine whether a fallback or handover was appropriate without the operating policy and authoritative logs.

documents.title: Planning and control evidence review guide
documents.reuse_basis: Original project-authored operational guide with an attributed link to an open-access CC BY scenario-framework reference. No article text is reproduced.
documents.summary: A guide for reviewing planning and control evidence while preserving the distinction between observed motion and a diagnosed stack defect.
investigation_prompts: Compare desired maneuver, feasible trajectory, vehicle response, lane relationship, and interaction context before assigning a planning or control hypothesis.
documents.limitations: Motion metrics alone cannot distinguish a planner defect, controller issue, environmental constraint, sensor error, or intentionally constrained fallback.
